note: Allowlist. Get your numeric user/chat IDs from a bot such as @userinfobot. BOTH lists are enforced: a message is processed only if its sender is in 'users' AND the chat is in 'chats'. The bot starts in deny-all mode until you add at least one entry to each. Edit this file and it is reloaded automatically (or send SIGHUP). IDs must be integers.
